ares v148 has now been released.

This release includes big improvements to a number of ares cores. Highlights include rewrites to the N64 CPU & RSP JITs resulting in significant performance gains across the N64 library, additional implementation & accuracy improvements to the PlayStation core, fixes to the GBA core, and support for the Famicom data recorder & Dendy. 

Additionally, there have been many updates to the core ares application across all platforms. Per-core input configuration has been added, updated video, audio, & input drivers are available, bug fixes, additional options have been added, and core dependencies have been updated. 

Since v147, 20 contributors have created 300 commits to the ares codebase.

As always, if you wish to see the full changelog in a per-commit format along with their authors, you can do so on GitHub [here](https://github.com/ares-emulator/ares/compare/v147...v148).

releases.name: Cemu Plus 0.4.1
releases.body:
Android build of Cemu Plus, a fork of the Cemu Android port with Lossless Scaling frame generation.

## What's new

### Game updates
- **Use update** in the settings of a game, under Update, turns its installed update off, and the game runs as its base version. It's only shown for games with an update, and applies the next time the game starts. The game card shows the version the game runs as
- Games whose update doesn't work in Cemu have it off by default, with a note under the switch saying it's recommended off. **Why?** opens the reason

### Fixes
- ZombiU no longer stays on a black screen after the Ubisoft logo. Its update (v32) doesn't work in Cemu, so it's off by default and ZombiU runs as its base version


## Frame generation setup
1. Copy `Lossless.dll` from your own copy of Lossless Scaling (its installation folder on Windows) to your device.
2. In Cemu Plus open **Settings → Graphics settings → Frame generation (Lossless Scaling)** and tap **Select Lossless.dll**.
3. Enable frame generation there or from the in-game menu, where the multiplier, target frame rate and motion estimation resolution can be changed while playing.

releases.name: Cemu Plus 0.4.0
releases.body:
Android build of Cemu Plus, a fork of the Cemu Android port with Lossless Scaling frame generation.

## What's new

### Motion sensitivity
- **Motion sensitivity X axis** and **Motion sensitivity Y axis** set how fast turning left and right, and tilting up and down go, from 25% to 500%. They are next to the motion inversion on each controller's page in **Input settings** and in the quick menu under Controls, and work for the motion of the device and of controllers
- They scale the turning speed the game gets, which is what aiming with motion uses. A tilt that is held still settles at the real angle of the device

### Updated to the latest Cemu
Cemu Plus now includes everything the main Cemu project added since April 2026:
- **Wii U CPU on ARM:** fixes in the ARM64 recompiler that runs every game, for single-precision float stores (now faster too), division by zero, carry flags and a few wrong instructions. The default NaN mode of ARM is turned off to match the Wii U
- **Performance:** smaller Vulkan and GPU optimizations, like checking only the render state that changed, caching shader lookups and using the fast draw path more often

# NFS Carbon Android v0.3.2

Carbon incorpora las mejoras de compatibilidad de Most Wanted 0.5.4, el selector de drivers Vulkan y las actualizaciones opcionales, conservando su launcher, idiomas y controles.

- Adaptación del renderer y de los shaders para GPU que admiten solo **cuatro conjuntos de descriptores**, presentes en algunos Mali y otros dispositivos.
- Conversión **BC4/BC5 en CPU con Xclipse** y el driver propietario de Samsung.

- **Drivers Vulkan externos:** importa, selecciona, prueba y elimina ZIPs Android ARM64. La prueba se ejecuta en un proceso independiente y muestra GPU, Vulkan y funciones disponibles. Puedes volver al driver del sistema.
- **Avisos opcionales de nuevas versiones** de este repositorio con **Actualizar** o **Más tarde**, más **Buscar actualizaciones** en el launcher. Puedes seguir jugando sin actualizar ni tener conexión; no se instalan ni descargan APKs automáticamente.

## NeoST 0.6.5

Rewind, a cleaner Shifter and DMA sound, smoother audio recovery, and many usability fixes.

Try it in the browser, nothing to install: **[habib256.github.io/neost](https://habib256.github.io/neost/)**.

**What's new**
- **Rewind**: Ctrl+Alt+R steps back in time, floppies included (off by default).
- **Accuracy**: Closure runs clean (no stray black frames, no flickering borders); STE DMA sound, Shifter hardscroll, IKBD and serial chips closer to the real hardware; selectable master crystal.
- **Games**: Lemmings, Pacemaker, Obsession and Extase join the games replayed against Hatari (27 in total); TOS 1.06 US boots.
- **Usability**: picking a machine model also picks a matching TOS, and picking a TOS adjusts the model; a quieter terminal (`--verbose` for the full log); adaptive zoom fixed on Enchanted Land; a warm reset or a config change no longer scrambles Spectrum 512 pictures; twelve more keyboard layouts; keyboard joystick fires with right Alt/Option instead of right Ctrl (MacBooks have none); joystick dongles offered only on the port their game reads; bitmap explorer in the debugger; MIDI split and Time Code.

releases.body:
## NeoST 0.6.4

**What's new**
- **Accuracy**: MFP timers start on their own clock edge (Lethal Xcess on STE gets its top border back); MFP, ACIA, SCC and WD1772 closer to their datasheets.
- **Mouse**: drag-and-drop works in games and on the desktop; Chessmaster is now playable.
- **Games**: Lethal Xcess, Golden Axe, Rick Dangerous and Pang join the games replayed against Hatari (23 in total).

releases.name: NeoST 0.6.3 — NetUSBee USB and built-in networking
releases.body:
## NeoST 0.6.3 — NetUSBee USB and built-in networking

- **NetUSBee USB devices:** connect a virtual USB keyboard, mouse or disk image
  to either port. Hot-plug devices in Configuration → Network, save them in
  profiles, or use `--usb1` / `--usb2` in the headless runner. USB4TOS drivers
  have been tested with keyboard input, mouse packets and file reads/writes.
  Disk images support read-only mounting. Native ST-side USB drivers are required.
- **Built-in NAT:** IPv4/IPv6 networking without libslirp or GLib, including
  DHCP, DNS, TCP/UDP and explicit port forwarding. STinG/ENEC can load HTTP pages.
- **Hardware accuracy:** further CPU, video, floppy, serial and sound fixes,
  backed by chip documentation and regression benches. Vroom Elite starts on STE.
- **Issue #44:** missing Atari ROMs are reported as skipped Spectrum 512 tests;
  available machines still detect regressions, and partial runs cannot overwrite
  the reference set.

**Save states use format v59. Older states cannot be loaded.** Disk image contents
remain external to save states. USB passthrough and isochronous transfers are not
implemented.

releases.body:
## NeoST 0.6.2 — closer to the metal

Seven weeks of hardware fidelity work since 0.6.1.

releases.body:
## NeoST 0.6.1 — your settings stay put

A patch release. No new features: **23 defects** found and fixed across five rounds of multi-agent bug hunting, plus a hardware-validation pass on the published packages.

### Settings are saved again

On macOS and on every AppImage, NeoST runs from **read-only media**, so it stores its configuration in your user directory — but it never created that directory, and every setting was silently lost when you closed the emulator. **Five of the eight packages were affected.** Machine profile, video, audio and MIDI setup now survive a restart.

### Also fixed

- **The macOS disk image installs by drag and drop.** It shipped with the app alone, no `Applications` shortcut.
- **The web build ships its licences** (GPL-3.0, GPL-2.0, third-party notices), like every other package.
- **A save-state can no longer be reloaded under a different ROM.** The pairing relied on two bytes of TOS version, which five localisations share, so resuming under the wrong ROM froze the CPU without a word. The state format is now **v19**; v18 and older are refused explicitly, with a message that says why.

releases.body:
# Pine Developer Diagnostics v1.3 — 开发预览

**这是诊断增强，不是 ART GC/堆损坏根因修复。** 复用已审查的 Debug APK，不重建、不重签；main 与旧预览 tag 不变。

源提交：`99115d70560c4872a094462bb179e0b772484d7f`；[草稿 PR #2](https://github.com/xmy953538104/pine_CN/pull/2)。

本轮修复 trace 临时失败的有限重试与成功升级导出、轮转后完整关键字段、CNMT/Program/SaveOwner 身份分离、按 generation 清理与 Java 故障身份保留，以及原生身份回调的共享实例锁。DFX 只来自真实 guest 消息；不保证闭源 Lua 栈。

## 实际验证

- FullDebug 构建、101 项 JVM、native/core/content、Windows PS5.1/pwsh 假 ADB 与匹配符号通过。
- Diagnostics CI 执行 `testFullDebugUnitTest processFullReleaseMainManifest assembleFullDebug`；原 CI 执行 `assembleFulldebug`。Release manifest 处理通过，**不称 FullRelease APK 构建通过**。

| 平台 | 实际报告 | 通过 | 阻塞 | 证据 |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|

This fresh application ID avoids requiring an uninstall or clearing old data.
It does not migrate another app's private settings, files, URI grants or exit
history. Configure lawful local content in the new app; do not share keys.
Continuous in-place Debug updates still require a stable development signer.

This revision repairs the identified VMA mapped-allocation contract and safe
failure for missing/revoked SAF content, including ACTION_VIEW metadata entry.
Controlled regressions pass; restored device game startup remains unverified.

It adds bounded asynchronous JSONL/PineDiag events, actual content selection and
storage observations, guest message/DFX forwarding, developer settings, redacted
export and Windows ADB collection. Main and emulation process logs are isolated.

releases.name: Stella 7.0 released
releases.body:
A new major release of Stella is now available; first time in over two years!  Here are some of the changes:

  * Enhanced ROM launcher to allow multiple images per ROM.

  * Made heaps of additional images available for the ROM launcher.

  * Added searching by filename for ROM launcher images.

  * Added option to start random ROM.

  * Added automatically enabled phosphor modes.

  * Enhanced Game Properties dialog for multigame ROMs.

  * Added 2nd UI theme and hotkey for toggling UI theme.

  * Added bezel support (incl. Sinden Lightgun).

  * Added optional type format detection based on colors used.

  * Added Joy2B+ controller support.

  * Added auto detection for QuadTari attached controllers.

  * Enhanced Kid Vid support to play tape audio.

  * Added port selection, used for controller default mapping.

  * Added missing PlusROM support for E7 bankswitching.

  * Enhanced movie cart (MVC) support.

  * Accelerated emulation up to ~15% (ARM).

  * Added limited GameLine Master Module bankswitching support.

  * Added 03E0 bankswitching for Brazilian Parker Bros ROMs.

  * Added WF8 bankswitching used by some certain Coleco white carts.

releases.name: Stella 6.7 released
releases.body:
This is a new semi-major release, with the following changes:
  * IMPORTANT NOTES:
    - Because of fixes to JSON handling, all remappings will be reset to defaults; if you had custom mappings, they will need to be re-entered again.
    - Because of internal changes, all state files are now invalid.

  * Completely reworked the file launcher:
    - Redesigned user interface
    - Added tracking of user favorites, recently played and most popular games
    - Added virtual directories for selecting tracked games
    - Added quick path navigation
    - Added navigation history
    - Added icons for files and directories
    - Added option to show/hide file extensions
    - Extended context menu and shortcuts
    - Fixed sluggish behaviour when reading large and/or invalid files

  * Added hotkey display to tooltips.

  * Added option to automatically pause emulation when focus is lost.

  * Added option to toggle autofire mode.

  * Improved controller mappings for Paddles.

  * Improved controller mappings for Driving controllers.

  * Improved Mindlink support.

  * Added another oddball TIA glitch option for score mode color.

  * Enhanced TV jitter emulation.

  * Added preliminary PlusROM support for saving high scores.

  * Added preliminary support for 'MVC' bankswitching scheme by Rob Bairos.

  * Added web links for many games.

  * Added dead zone and linearity settings for analog controllers.

  * Added 'Check for Update' button to Help dialog.

  * Added different mask patterns for scanline emulation.

  * Fixed MindLink controller.

  * Added different debug color luminances for player and missile copies.

  * Added hotkeys for TV roll speed and toggling 'Developer settings' sets.

  * Debugger: enhanced prompt's auto complete and history.

  * Debugger: added optional logging of breaks and traps.

  * Debugger: added Thumb cycle counting.

  * Fixed QuadTari support for controller types other than Joysticks.

  * Fixed palette and TV effects saving for Retron77.

  * Fixed immediate disassembling when switching options in debugger.

Uninstall first, then install the new project if you want to switch.

releases.body:
Merry Christmas, Happy Holidays and a Happy New Year everyone!

This update adds experimental Online Multiplayer to NetherSX2 along with the usual updates!
Thanks to [IamLupo](https://github.com/IamLupo) for adding it to ARMSX2, and [zakilj3](https://www.youtube.com/user/zakilj3) for discovering the same settings work with NetherSX2!

## How to use Online Multiplayer
1. Go to your App Settings --> Settings and toggle on Enable DEV9 Ethernet
2. Set API to Sockets, and Device to how you want to connect online with the default being WiFi. Set this to VPN if your phone uses a VPN, and to one of the two SIM DATA options if you want to use your Mobile Data Plan instead
3. That should be enough to get you online using a guide like [this](https://youtu.be/dcOnZzzcbSc?si=WOf01r0Ln5ZVQkpf&t=278) by LogicalMacrochip

# Minimum System Requirements for Winlator WB64:
- __OS (Operating System):__ Android 7.0 or later
- __Processor/CPU (Central Processing Unit):__ Qualcomm Snapdragon 460 or higher
- __GPU (Graphics Processing Unit):__ Adreno 610 or higher 
- __Graphics API:__ Vulkan 1.1 or higher
- __Internal Storage:__ At least 2GB of free space
- __RAM (Random Access Memory):__ At least 1GB of free RAM available, depending on the game requirments
- __Root Access:__ Not required
- __Gamepad:__ Optional (xinput/xbox recommended)


__NOTE: Recommended for game titles released before 2013 or DX9-based, Some games especially those from 2013 onwards, may experience performance issues.__
__Results can vary based on the device used, environmental conditions, and other factors, such as simultaneous processing, and different processor capabilities.__

__Please be careful when downloading from other websites. We recommend downloading only from this GitHub repository or official.__

✅ __[WINLATOR.ORG](https://winlator.org) is the original site.__

releases.name: Xenra v0.5.0
releases.body:
## Xenra 0.5.0

### A new platform: iOS

Xenra ships on iPad and iPhone for the first time, as one app with both
consoles:

- Xbox 360 and original Xbox cores, the Metal renderer, JIT through StikDebug,
  and the floating pad with physical controller support.
- Dashboard, game library with box art and covers, setup wizard, per-game
  settings, sharing logs, crash and thermal reports.
- Xbox 360 System Link netplay over the local network, with a signed-in profile.
- Original Xbox Live through Insignia: console DNS, setup assistant and the
  retail dashboard, all from the app.

The iOS and Android screens share their wording and layout, so a guide written
for one applies to the other.

### Original Xbox: the Performance core

The Performance core is the default original Xbox core on Android, chosen per
game at launch. xemu remains for the dashboard, the Insignia setup assistant and
the games the performance core cannot run, exactly the split the game menu
already understands. The core names in the library and per-game settings are now
Performance and Compatibility, matching the 360 side.

### Mali GPUs and compatibility rendering

## Xenra 0.4.5 (pre-release)

The biggest performance update yet, on both consoles.

### Performance and Compatibility cores
Every game, Original Xbox and Xbox 360, now has two cores. Performance is the default; switch any game from its menu in the library.

### Original Xbox
- New Performance core, integrated with Xenra's controls, display options and in-game menu. Most games run at full speed; Forza Motorsport 12 -> 30 fps.
- Compatibility core updated to the latest xemu, with the upstream graphics accuracy fixes (lighting, vertex shaders, textures, surfaces, timers).
- Crash and stability fixes across the renderer, audio and save states.

### Xbox 360
- Major GPU overhaul: Forza Horizon 2 10 -> 30 fps, Halo 3 up to 2x faster.
- Game fixes including Forza Motorsport 4, Need for Speed: Most Wanted, Gears of War 3, Rise of the Tomb Raider and Crysis 3.
- Synced with the latest Xenia Edge.
- Fixed textures and objects disappearing for a frame.
- GTA V boots again with its title update installed.
- Custom GPU drivers can run the GPU at full clocks.

### App
- Fixes across the library, settings, save states and the setup wizard.

### Known issues

Access the dedicated **Game Data** menu by long-pressing any title in your library:

---

* **Render Pipeline Optimizations:** Refined render-target handling and GPU synchronization eliminate unnecessary render passes, improving frame rates on mobile hardware.
* **Faster Rendering Path:** Fixed an underlying bottleneck, allowing default `gpu_upstream_conformance` to drop from 15 to 14. Existing configurations migrate automatically.

**Cheats, under CTRL** (requested in #1).

- **Infinite EP:** EP stays at its maximum, so Teleport, Chronostasis and every other EP ability cost nothing.
- **Freeze the clock:** the game's clock stands still, so the days do not pass.

Both are off by default. Tap **CTRL** at the top of the screen, scroll down to *Cheats*, tick what you want and tap **Apply**: they take effect at once, without a restart, and stay set for the next start. A save made while a cheat is on keeps its effects (a frozen clock stays at its time).

**New name and icon:** the app is now called **LR:FFXIII** on your home screen and in the app drawer, with the game's emblem as its icon.

**Updating from v1.1:** install `lr-recomp-android-arm64.apk` (below) over it. Your saves, game files and shaders are kept. If you downloaded v1.2 in its first hours (still named *Lightning Returns Recomp*), install it again for the new name and icon; nothing else changed.

releases.name: v1.1: download the APK
releases.body:
**Download the APK, pick your ISO, play.** No PC needed any more.

1. Install `lr-recomp-android-arm64.apk` (below) on your device.
2. Put an ISO of your own **USA** disc of *Lightning Returns: Final Fantasy XIII* on the device.
3. Start the app and tap **Import from ISO…** on the *Game folder* page (keep the bundled Turnip driver if the GPU driver page comes up). When the import is done, tap **Start game**.

**The first start takes a few minutes, with the progress on screen** (times from the AYN Thor): about 45 s of *Loading…*, about 45 s of *Preparing shaders* (the game waits; hold START + BACK for 2 s to skip), then about 3.5 minutes of *Compiling the remaining shaders* in the corner of the title, where you can already play (starting the game pauses it until the next start). Later starts are quick and don't stutter.

First public release of the source.

**No APK is attached, on purpose.** The APK contains code generated from the game's executable, so you build your own from your own copy of the game. See the README: one command, `tools/quickstart.sh`.

Highlights:
- A second screen on dual-screen devices such as the AYN Thor: schemata, enemy weaknesses and EP in battle, and an area map that follows the camera in the field.
- 30, 40 or 60 fps in gameplay, measured in the Thor's lowest power mode (Standard) on the Snapdragon 8 Gen 2.
- The Turnip GPU driver is bundled, shaders are precompiled at the title screen, and the game can be imported from an ISO on the device.

Attached: a 2-minute video recorded on the AYN Thor, both screens at 60 fps, in 1080p and a smaller 720p version. Screen recording costs some frame rate, so judge performance by the README's numbers, not by this video.

releases.name: v2.5.17 — Microsoft sign-in
releases.body:
## What's new

- **Microsoft sign-in no longer opens a blank white page** ([#3](https://github.com/FlameLaunchers/FlameLauncher-Android/issues/3)). Android's WebView puts `; wv` in its user agent, Microsoft reads that as an embedded browser and refuses the page — and what you get is not a message, it is an empty white screen. The marker is gone from the user agent now.

  Two more things the sign-in page needs were missing: cross-site cookies, which `login.live.com` relies on, and a `WebChromeClient`, without which the popups and dialogs the flow opens are silently dropped. The iOS build never hit any of this because WKWebView reports itself as Safari and handles those by default.
- **A sign-in page that fails to load now says why.** Main-frame errors were going nowhere, so a failure left the same white screen with nothing to report.

releases.name: v2.5.16 — Minecraft 26.4 snapshots
releases.body:
## What's new

- **Minecraft 26.4 snapshots start.** A version id like `26.4-snapshot-3` splits into `26` and `4-snapshot-3`, and reading that second part as a plain integer gave nothing — so 26.4 was treated as 26.0, missed the SDL and LWJGL 3.4.3 stack, and launched on LWJGL 3.3.6 instead. The game died immediately with `NoClassDefFoundError: org/lwjgl/sdl/SDLPlatform`; the cacio lines in the crash report were a consequence, not the cause. Version numbers are now read digit by digit, so snapshot, pre-release and rc suffixes no longer hide them, and five tests cover the shapes.
- Carries the previous fix as well: on Java 24 and newer the cacio java agent is skipped, because the `sun.misc.Unsafe` calls its `premain` depends on are refused there and a failing agent takes the VM with it.

releases.name: v2.5.15 — Minecraft 26.4 starts again
releases.body:
## What's new

- **Minecraft 26.4 (and anything else on Java 24 or newer) starts again.** The cacio setup loaded a java agent whose `premain` overwrites the AWT toolkit's static fields through `sun.misc.Unsafe` (`staticFieldBase`, `staticFieldOffset`, `putObject`). Those methods are refused from JDK 24 and gone in 26, and a failing agent takes the whole VM down with it — which surfaced as a cacio error at startup.

  The iOS build has always run the same cacio jars without that agent, on the same Java 25, using only `-Dawt.toolkit` and `-Xbootclasspath/a`. Android now does the same on Java 24+ and keeps the agent only for the older runtimes that still need it.

releases.name: Spektralab-X 0.2.00-alpha-6
releases.body:
**省流：** 不选胶卷也能只用滤镜保存图片，自定义组合保存得更完整；RAW 少占一些内存，测光和曲线少做重复计算。界面保持原样，未大规模真机验证，需要社区反馈。

内部安装版本码递增为 **126**，沿用原发布签名，可覆盖安装。本轮共创：**GPT（OpenAI，AI 助手）**。

### 滤镜和胶卷自由搭配

- 胶卷选“无”后，数字调色和 LUT 继续生效，可通过原有保存入口导出图片。胶卷、相纸和数字调整按用户现有选择组合，不增加模式或范围控件。
- “存为风格”和“分享当前风格”记录当前完整选择，包括明确的无胶卷状态、物理细调、效果开关及记住的强度；重新套用时不再漏掉这些设置。局部蒙版留在当前照片，RAW 白平衡、裁切和边框不进入可复用风格。
- 新版 `.spklook` 写出 version 2，并继续读取旧 version 1 文件。旧应用不能保证还原 v2 的全部新语义；自定义配方基于已有胶卷、相纸及参数，每张图仍使用一个物理方案和一个数字调色层 / LUT。

### RAW 少复制，计算少重复

- 对满足条件的整数 RAW，将解码结果直接转换到工作尺寸，避免先创建完整的浮点中间图；最终 Bitmap 分配前释放已用完的原始存储。
- 对严格兼容的整数 LinearRaw 子集，一次性处理直接接管已有像素存储，减少一份整图复制。浮点精度路径、黑白点及方向处理保留原有约定，并检查取消和失败时的存储状态。
- 同一次显示计算只准备一次曲线；自动测光和场景亮度统计复用已完成的精确分区，减少重复选择工作。逐项对照保留原有数值结果，没有更换胶片光谱、默认显影或成像公式。
- 吸收上游 Sony Huffman 解码缓存索引保护，保留合法索引的既有计算；尚未用真实问题 Sony 原片完成复现验收。

### 验证范围

本轮分项云端验证包含 172 项 Release JVM 测试、3 项原有界面风格保存 / 导入测试、完整 LibRaw 的 ASan / UBSan 检查、ARM64 JNI 编译，以及测光和场景统计的 1460 项数值对照；真实 Vulkan 胶片与印放对照输出保持一致。发布仍须通过整包构建、原生回归、签名证书及 16 KiB 对齐检查。

**未大规模真机验证，需要社区反馈。** 云端的耗时及内存改善不等于手机整张导出同比提速，也不保证所有 RAW 都降低峰值。新 RAW 仍默认线性显示，递归模糊、交互色表及完整外存分块实验继续默认关闭。

releases.name: Spektralab-X 0.2.00-alpha-5
releases.body:
**省流：** 修复异常像素被当成正常照片保存，出错后重建引擎重算。未大规模真机验证，需要社区反馈。

这次集中处理社区 [#17](https://github.com/Dear-Ded/Spektralab-X/issues/17) 反馈的窄条画面、黑块和紫色色块。暗房里算坏的底片，不能盖个“保存成功”就交卷。

内部安装版本码递增为 **125**，沿用原发布签名，可覆盖安装。本轮共创：**GPT（OpenAI，AI 助手）**。

### 修复异常像素被放行

- 修复浮点 RGB 中的 NaN、正负无穷在转成整数时丢失错误信息的问题。这些值原来会变成黑色或偏色像素，alpha 和文件结构却仍然正常；只要局部还有画面，旧的纯色检查就可能放行。
- 现在在整数转换和结果缓存前扫描全部 RGB 通道，记录首个异常像素的位置和通道；同时检查扫描工作组是否完整执行。异常结果停止交付，不进入后续保存。
- 导出前还会核对 RGBA16 布局及每个有效像素的 alpha，拦截未完整写入的结果。普通 Bitmap 导出、胶片 JPEG 4:4:4 和 RGBA16 TIFF 共用这项检查。

### 出错后重新开一间暗房

- 异常帧重试先重建 GPU 引擎，丢弃出错引擎的缓存和池状态，再降低工作尺寸重算。修复原来降档后仍沿用同一个引擎的问题。
- 第二次仍异常时停止保存，并替换异常引擎。诊断信息保留原始错误、像素坐标或缺失工作组数，便于后续定位。
- 正常照片的成像计算保持原有路径；新 RAW 继续默认线性显示，递归模糊等实验模式仍默认关闭。

### 验证与后续反馈

releases.name: XRecomp v0.13.4
releases.body:
# XRecomp 0.13.4

<!-- Highlights: what changed, what works, known problems. Written by hand, kept across updates. -->

A fix release.

- **Titles that reserve their own memory above RAM now start.** A title whose allocator looks for free space with
  VirtualQuery and then reserves exactly there (Yu-Gi-Oh! The Dawn of Destiny, Intrinsic Alchemy engine) never found
  a region big enough: free space was reported page by page. Its memory pool stayed empty and it stayed on a black
  screen before its first frame. Free space is now reported as one region and a reservation at the asked address is
  honoured.
- **Functions after a call that never returns** (`call exit; int3`, `call _CxxThrowException; int3`) are no longer
  swallowed by the function before them. A first run after a fresh Prepare no longer stops on them.
- **KeBugCheck stops the game** with one clear line (and, on Android, a message) instead of returning into it, which
  looped millions of times and then crashed.

After updating, press **Prepare again** on an affected title (Home says it was prepared by an older version).

## Changes

releases.body:
# XRecomp 0.13.2

A small release of fixes, and the first one cut by the new release PR (docs/releases/README.md).

## Xbox

- **Black screen at boot**: a game that scans its memory map region by region (Yu-Gi-Oh! The Dawn of Destiny) no
  longer loops for ever past the top of user space; the kernel now stops it there as the console does.
- **Save states**: capturing a state no longer fails now and then with « freeze failed » while every thread was
  in fact stopped.

**Prepare your Xbox games again** to get these fixes (their Home offers it).

## Mac

- The toolkit builds again with the Nintendo DS, PSP, Dreamcast and PS2 players (they could not find their core's
  headers).

## Known problems

- Unchanged from 0.13.1: no cloud saves in this download; Resume where you left off does not show yet on device for
  the Xbox titles we tried; about one boot in ten of SpikeOut: Battle Street stays on a black screen; the Windows
  download has never been tried on a Windows PC by us.

## Before you install

- 0.12.2 and later offer this update themselves. Older versions and `xrecomp-latest`: install it by hand, in place
  (same signing key). Saves, states and settings are kept.
